title_zh: 巴基斯坦夺取反对派领导省份的控制权
summary_zh: 联邦政府谈到开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省在武装暴力事件中“法律和秩序严重崩溃”，并任命一名政治盟友官员负责。

title_en: India’s ‘Cockroach’ Leaders Released as Small Protests Go On in Delhi
summary_en: The leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party, an Indian youth movement, had been detained by the police on Saturday before they could lead protests over voting rights.
title_zh: 德里小规模抗议活动持续，印度“蟑螂”领导人被释放
summary_zh: 印度青年运动“蟑螂简塔党”的领导人周六在领导有关投票权的抗议活动之前被警方拘留。

title_en: A Reporter Returns to China to Find it Richer, but Also Highly Paranoid.
summary_en: Returning to China after decades away, a correspondent finds bullet trains, dazzling skylines — and a surveillance state more paranoid and pervasive than ever.
title_zh: 一名记者回到中国，发现中国更加富裕，但也高度偏执。
summary_zh: 几十年后回到中国，一名记者发现子弹头列车、令人眼花缭乱的天际线，以及比以往任何时候都更加偏执和普遍的监视状态。

title_en: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
summary_en: A desperate junta is in a war of attrition against ethnic militias and civilian resistance.
title_zh: 年轻人生活在害怕被从街上抓走并卖给缅甸军队的恐惧之中
summary_zh: 绝望的军政府正在与少数民族民兵和平民抵抗进行消耗战。

title_en: Thousands detained in New Delhi as police crack down on 'cockroach' movement
summary_en: Police detained “cockroach movement” leader Abhijeet Dipke and two others as hundreds of protesters defied a heavy security clampdown in New Delhi.
title_zh: 新德里警方镇压“蟑螂”活动，数千人被拘留
summary_zh: 新德里数百名抗议者无视安全部门的严厉镇压，警方拘留了“蟑螂运动”领导人阿比吉特·迪普克和另外两人。

title_en: ‘Cockroach’ leader among thousands detained in Delhi protest crackdown
summary_en: Authorities impose strict lockdown in capital to try to stop rally against removal of 130m names from electoral roll Indian authorities have placed Delhi under a severe lockdown and detained tens of thousands of people, including the leader of the youth-led “Cockroach” movement, in an attempt to stop an anti-government protest. Thousands of people from across India were blocked from attending the demonstration, which had been called by the “Cockroach Janata party” (CJP) to protest against an exercise that has stripped 130m names from India’s electoral roll. Continue reading...
title_zh: 德里抗议镇压中数千名“蟑螂”头目被拘留
summary_zh: 当局在首都实施严格封锁，试图阻止反对从选民名册上删除 1.3 亿人姓名的集会 印度当局对德里实施了严格封锁，并拘留了数万人，其中包括青年领导的“蟑螂”运动的领导人，试图阻止反政府抗议活动。来自印度各地的数千人被阻止参加这场由“蟑螂人民党”(CJP) 发起的示威活动，以抗议一项将 1.3 亿人的名字从印度选民名册上抹去的行动。继续阅读...

title_en: Cop31 host urges wealthy countries to spend ‘much more’ on climate than defence
summary_en: ‘The climate issue is the security issue,’ says Turkish minister at Pacific pre-Cop summit in Fiji Wealthy countries should spend far more on dealing with the climate crisis than the 5% of GDP promised by Nato members for defence because “the climate issue is the security issue”, the host of the next UN summit has said. But, in comments that are likely to prove contentious, the Cop31 president-designate, Murat Kurum, hedged on whether countries should try to repeat a previous agreement to “transition away from fossil fuels” – the primary cause of the climate crisis – when they meet in Turkey n
title_zh: 第三十一届缔约方会议主办方敦促富裕国家在气候方面投入“更多”而不是在国防方面
summary_zh: 土耳其部长在斐济举行的太平洋预科峰会上表示，“气候问题就是安全问题”。 下一届联合国峰会的东道主表示，富裕国家应对气候危机的支出应该远远超过北约成员国承诺的占国内生产总值 5% 的国防开支，因为“气候问题就是安全问题”。但是，第三十一届缔约方大会候任主席穆拉特·库鲁姆 (Murat Kurum) 在发表可能引起争议的评论时，回避了各国在土耳其举行会议时是否应尝试重复之前达成的“摆脱化石燃料”协议（气候危机的主要原因）的问题。

title_en: Meet India's feisty Gen Z protester who is taking on Modi
summary_en: Neha Bora has emerged as one of the most recognisable faces from India's recent Gen Z-led protests.
title_zh: 来认识一下正在与莫迪较量的印度精力充沛的 Z 世代抗议者
summary_zh: 尼哈·博拉 (Neha Bora) 已成为印度最近 Z 世代领导的抗议活动中最知名的面孔之一。

title_en: Sydney trader sacked for working from Singapore without permission wins unfair dismissal case
summary_en: Employee had also been in Bali when he told his manager he was working from home, Fair Work Commission hears Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A Sydney currency trader who was sacked for working from Singapore without approval has won an unfair dismissal case, but failed to be awarded compensation. The Fair Work Commission ruled on Wednesday that Charles Graham had been unfairly dismissed by HIFX Australia, trading as Xe, in December last year. Continue reading...
title_zh: 悉尼交易员因未经许可在新加坡工作而被解雇 赢得不公平解雇案
summary_zh: 一名悉尼货币交易员因未经批准在新加坡工作而被解雇，他在不公平解雇案中胜诉，但未能获得赔偿。公平工作委员会周三裁定，去年 12 月 Charles Graham 被 HIFX Australia（交易名为 Xe）不公平地解雇。继续阅读...

title_en: India’s ‘Cockroach’ party accuses government of mass detention of members ahead of weekend protest
summary_en: Thousands expected to march in Delhi on Saturday, as anger mounts over controversial changes to voter lists in world’s largest democracy India’s Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), which began as a satirical movement but is now emerging as a political force among gen Z’s, says authorities have begun detaining its members en masse days before a major anti-government protest in Delhi. Opposition parties, their student units, and the “Cockroach” youth movement have been holding almost daily demonstrations seeking the resignation of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over a controversial revision
title_zh: 印度“蟑螂”党指责政府在周末抗议前大规模拘留党员
summary_zh: 周六，数千人预计将在德里游行，因为世界上最大的民主国家印度蟑螂简塔党（CJP）选民名单的争议性变化引发了人们的愤怒。该党最初是一场讽刺运动，但现在正在成为 Z 世代中的一支政治力量。该党表示，在德里举行重大反政府抗议活动的几天前，当局已开始大规模拘留其党员。反对党、其学生团体和“蟑螂”青年运动几乎每天都举行示威活动，要求首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔因一项有争议的修订案辞职

title_en: Alleged Chinese agent to remain in custody, judge rules, amid flight-risk fears
summary_en: California realtor Wanying Zhang is facing federal prosecution for allegedly surveilling the Taiwanese president's son in Washington last year at the direction of Chinese government officials.
title_zh: 法官裁定，因担心潜逃风险，被指控的中国特工仍将被拘留
summary_zh: 加州房地产经纪人张万英因涉嫌去年在中国政府官员的指示下在华盛顿监视台湾总统的儿子而面临联邦起诉。

title_en: Japanese leader calls woman's murder, allegedly by U.S. Marine, "heinous crime"
summary_en: A woman's murder allegedly committed by a U.S. Marine​ in Okinawa is a "heinous crime," Japan's premier said on Monday, as the new accusation of violence involving American forces sparked public outrage.
title_zh: 日本领导人称美国海军陆战队谋杀妇女事件为“令人发指的罪行”
summary_zh: 日本首相周一表示，一名美国海军陆战队员在冲绳谋杀一名妇女是“令人发指的罪行”，因为涉及美军的暴力行为的新指控引发了公众的愤怒。

title_en: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes

summary_zh: 万科的麻烦引发了人们对房地产危机持续蔓延以及中国政府是否会介入的疑问。

title_en: Italy Supports Saudi Arabia Joining Fighter-Jet Program, PM Meloni Says
summary_en: The U.K., Italy and Japan have already partnered on the Global Combat Air Programme, which aims to put a new stealth fighter with supersonic capability in the skies by 2035.
title_zh: 总理梅洛尼表示，意大利支持沙特阿拉伯加入战斗机计划
summary_zh: 英国、意大利和日本已经就全球空战计划展开合作，该计划的目标是到 2035 年将具有超音速能力的新型隐形战斗机送上天空。

title_en: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
summary_en: The dictator, eager to shut out the influence of Hollywood and K-pop, has been exalting a “shock brigade” of 300,000 teens and 20-somethings drafted into flood reconstruction.
title_zh: 金正恩正在尽一切努力让朝鲜年轻人保持一致
summary_zh: 这位独裁者急于排除好莱坞和韩国流行音乐的影响，一直在赞扬一支由 30 万青少年和 20 多岁的年轻人组成的“突击队”，被征召参加洪水重建。

title_en: Germany's Economic Model Is Broken, and No One Has a Plan B
summary_en: The country is focused on exports, but China is slowing imports and U.S. tariff threats are growing. Politicians are offering few alternatives.
title_zh: 德国经济模式已被打破，没有人有备用计划
summary_zh: 该国专注于出口，但中国正在放缓进口，而美国的关税威胁正在加剧。政客们几乎没有提供任何替代方案。

title_en: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
summary_en: The Chinese foreign minister spoke by phone with Marco Rubio, the new secretary of state who has been a critic of Beijing.
title_zh: 北京表示愿意与特朗普团队，甚至是宿敌进行对话
summary_zh: 中国外交部长与一直批评北京的新任国务卿马可·卢比奥通了电话。

title_en: Scientists film deepest ever fish on seabed off Japan
summary_en: Cruising at a depth of 8,336 meters (over 27,000 feet) just above the seabed, a young snailfish has become the deepest fish ever filmed by scientists during a probe into the abyss of the northern Pacific Ocean.
title_zh: 科学家在日本海域拍摄有史以来最深的鱼类
summary_zh: 一只小蜗牛鱼在海床上方 8,336 米（超过 27,000 英尺）的深度巡航，成为科学家在北太平洋深渊探测过程中拍摄到的最深的鱼类。

title_en: Beijing promised to 'fight back' over Taiwan leader's US visit. But this time it has more to lose
summary_en: An anticipated meeting between Taiwan's President Tsai Ing-wen and US House Speaker Kevin McCarthy in California this week has sparked concerns of a repeat of the pressure campaign China launched last year when then-Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei.
title_zh: 北京承诺将对台湾领导人访美进行“反击”。但这一次失去的更多
summary_zh: 台湾总统蔡英文和美国众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡本周将在加利福尼亚州举行会晤，这引发了人们对中国去年时任众议院议长南希·佩洛西访问台北时发起的施压行动的重演。

title_en: Micron Technology: China probes US chip maker for cybersecurity risks as tech tension escalates
summary_en: China has launched a cybersecurity probe into Micron Technology, one of America's largest memory chip makers, in apparent retaliation after US allies in Asia and Europe announced new restrictions on the sale of key technology to Beijing.
title_zh: 美光科技：随着技术紧张局势升级，中国调查美国芯片制造商的网络安全风险
summary_zh: 中国对美国最大的存储芯片制造商之一美光科技发起网络安全调查，这显然是对美国在亚洲和欧洲的盟友宣布对向北京出售关键技术实施新限制的报复。

title_en: Suspected Chinese spy balloon was able to transmit information back to Beijing
summary_en: The suspected Chinese spy balloon that transited the US earlier this year was able to capture imagery and collect some signals intelligence from US military sites, a source familiar with the matter tells CNN.
title_zh: 疑似中国间谍气球能够将信息传回北京
summary_zh: 一位知情人士告诉美国有线电视新闻网，今年早些时候飞越美国的疑似中国间谍气球能够从美国军事地点捕获图像并收集一些信号情报。

title_en: China Renaissance suspends trading, delays results after founder's disappearance
summary_en: China Renaissance, a top dealmaker in the country's tech industry, said it would suspend trading of its shares and delay the release of its annual results because it still can't get in touch with its founder.
title_zh: 创始人失踪后华兴资本暂停交易并推迟公布业绩
summary_zh: 中国科技行业最大的交易撮合者华兴资本表示，由于仍无法与其创始人取得联系，因此将暂停其股票交易并推迟发布年度业绩。
